name: design
description: Make and revise designs in the Design (canvas) format as local files: project/canvas.json places artboards on an infinite canvas, and each artboard is one live .dc.html Design Component file. A local page shows the artboards side by side and lets people move them, retype copy, adjust tweaks and send requests back to the agent. Use when someone asks for UI screens, a landing page or web page design, app mockups, component explorations, diagrams, print pieces or a clickable prototype as an editable canvas, names the Design (canvas) type, or wants to change a folder that holds project/canvas.json. Can install a design system and build with its tokens and real components. Not for a one-off HTML file outside this format or a slide deck.
